exposure: Racial minority status (minority [Black or Asian] vs. White)
Women aged 40 years or older undergoing IVF
cohort: The study included women aged 40 years or older undergoing their first IVF cycle with fresh cleavage-stage embryo transfer, stratified by racial minority status.
finding: Minority women of advanced reproductive age are less likely to achieve a pregnancy compared with white (non-Hispanic) women, but once pregnancy is achieved, live birth rates are similar, although minority women experience higher rates of preterm delivery.
birth_weight: All babies born from the IVF cycles were included, with small for gestational age measured as an outcome.
gest_age: All babies born from the IVF cycles were included, with gestational age at delivery measured as an outcome, specifically for preterm (<37 weeks) and extreme preterm (24-28 weeks) births.
